name: costa-rica-checkout-for-woocommerce
description: SINPE Móvil, exchange rate, provinces/cantons/districts and ID number for WooCommerce stores in Costa Rica.
author: Ariel Orozco

scripts.lint:js: wp-scripts lint-js assets/src tests/e2e bin playwright.config.js webpack.config.js eslint.config.cjs --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.test:php: npm run test:php:unit && npm run test:php:integration
scripts.env:start: wp-env start && wp-env run cli wp plugin activate costa-rica-checkout-for-woocommerce
scripts.env:start:min: wp-env start --config=.wp-env.min.json && wp-env run cli --config=.wp-env.min.json wp plugin activate costa-rica-checkout-for-woocommerce
scripts.plugin-check: npm run zip && wp-env run cli wp plugin check wp-content/plugins/costa-rica-checkout-for-woocommerce/build/costa-rica-checkout-for-woocommerce --slug=costa-rica-checkout-for-woocommerce
scripts.i18n:pot: npm run build && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/costa-rica-checkout-for-woocommerce wp i18n make-pot . languages/costa-rica-checkout-for-woocommerce.pot --exclude=assets/src,bin,build/costa-rica-checkout-for-woocommerce,dist,node_modules,tests,vendor --headers='{"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To":"https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/costa-rica-checkout-for-woocommerce"}'
scripts.i18n:compile: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/costa-rica-checkout-for-woocommerce bash -c 'wp i18n make-mo languages && wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge'
